title: Use a structured Seedance prompt template with labeled sections (Style…
content:
Use a structured Seedance prompt template with labeled sections (Style, Cinematography, Lighting, Color, Camera, Skin, Acting, Physics, Composition, Continuity, Technical, Audio) to force specific controllable attributes instead of vague descriptors  
Specify MULTISHOT with exact timecodes and “hard cut” instructions per shot to control pacing and editing across a 15s sequence  
Lock character identity by explicitly stating “character matches input 100%” and “no identity drift” to reduce subject drift across cuts  
Clarify reference-image usage by stating the image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (not a fixed keyframe) and instruct Seedance to extend the world with new buildings/angles so it doesn’t recreate the input frame 1:1  
Control motion cadence by explicitly setting 24fps and banning slow motion (“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”)  
Reduce instability artifacts by explicitly instructing “No jitter” while separately defining intentional handheld shake parameters (e.g., 4–8cm bounce, organic human jitter, no stabilization)  
Direct camera behavior per shot by specifying FOV values, dutch angle degrees, and movement (tracking, whip, arc, push-in, recoil) for each cut  
Enforce a consistent look by specifying white balance (WB 6500K) and a 60:30:10 dominant/secondary/accent color ratio  
Prevent unwanted stylization by adding negative constraints like “Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” and “NO glowing eyes”  
Improve realism by explicitly prompting physical cues (180° shutter motion blur, gravity/inertia, correct contact shadows, visible breath/chest rise, pore-level skin detail)  
Constrain output format and ending by specifying 16:9 and “Cut to black at end”  
Control audio generation by specifying “Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.”

es.content:
Usa una plantilla estructurada de prompt de Seedance con secciones etiquetadas (Style, Cinematography, Lighting, Color, Camera, Skin, Acting, Physics, Composition, Continuity, Technical, Audio) para forzar atributos específicos y controlables en lugar de descriptores vagos  
Especifica MULTISHOT con timecodes exactos e instrucciones de “hard cut” por toma para controlar el ritmo y la edición a lo largo de una secuencia de 15 s  
Bloquea la identidad del personaje indicando explícitamente “character matches input 100%” y “no identity drift” para reducir el subject drift entre cortes  
Aclara el uso de la imagen de referencia indicando que la imagen es SOLO UNA STYLE REFERENCE (no un keyframe fijo) e instruye a Seedance a ampliar el mundo con nuevos edificios/ángulos para que no recree el frame de entrada 1:1  
Controla la cadencia del movimiento estableciendo explícitamente 24fps y prohibiendo el slow motion (“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”)  
Reduce los artefactos de inestabilidad instruyendo explícitamente “No jitter” mientras defines por separado parámetros intencionales de handheld shake (p. ej., rebote de 4–8 cm, organic human jitter, no stabilization)  
Dirige el comportamiento de la cámara por toma especificando valores de FOV, grados de dutch angle y movimiento (tracking, whip, arc, push-in, recoil) para cada corte  
Impone un look consistente especificando white balance (WB 6500K) y una proporción de color dominante/secundario/acento de 60:30:10  
Evita la estilización no deseada añadiendo restricciones negativas como “Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” y “NO glowing eyes”  
Mejora el realismo indicando explícitamente señales físicas (motion blur con shutter de 180°, gravedad/inercia, sombras de contacto correctas, respiración visible/ascenso del pecho, detalle de la piel a nivel de poros)  
Restringe el formato de salida y el final especificando 16:9 y “Cut to black at end”  
Controla la generación de audio especificando “Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.”

fr.content:
Utilisez un modèle de prompt Seedance structuré avec des sections étiquetées (Style, Cinematography, Lighting, Color, Camera, Skin, Acting, Physics, Composition, Continuity, Technical, Audio) afin d’imposer des attributs contrôlables spécifiques au lieu de descripteurs vagues  
Spécifiez MULTISHOT avec des timecodes exacts et des instructions de “hard cut” pour chaque plan afin de contrôler le rythme et le montage sur une séquence de 15 s  
Verrouillez l’identité du personnage en indiquant explicitement “character matches input 100%” et “no identity drift” pour réduire la dérive du sujet entre les cuts  
Clarifiez l’utilisation de l’image de référence en précisant que l’image est STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (pas un keyframe fixe) et demandez à Seedance d’étendre le monde avec de nouveaux bâtiments/angles afin qu’il ne recrée pas le cadre d’entrée à l’identique (1:1)  
Contrôlez la cadence du mouvement en définissant explicitement 24fps et en interdisant le slow motion (“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”)  
Réduisez les artefacts d’instabilité en indiquant explicitement “No jitter” tout en définissant séparément des paramètres intentionnels de handheld shake (par ex. 4–8 cm de bounce, organic human jitter, no stabilization)  
Orientez le comportement de la caméra plan par plan en spécifiant des valeurs de FOV, des degrés de dutch angle et le mouvement (tracking, whip, arc, push-in, recoil) pour chaque cut  
Imposez un rendu cohérent en spécifiant la white balance (WB 6500K) et un ratio de couleurs dominant/secondaire/accent de 60:30:10  
Évitez une stylisation indésirable en ajoutant des contraintes négatives comme “Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” et “NO glowing eyes”  
Améliorez le réalisme en demandant explicitement des indices physiques (motion blur avec shutter 180°, gravity/inertia, correct contact shadows, visible breath/chest rise, pore-level skin detail)  
Contraignez le format de sortie et la fin en spécifiant 16:9 et “Cut to black at end”  
Contrôlez la génération audio en spécifiant “Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.”

ja.content:
構造化された Seedance プロンプトテンプレートを、ラベル付きセクション（Style、Cinematography、Lighting、Color、Camera、Skin、Acting、Physics、Composition、Continuity、Technical、Audio）で使用し、曖昧な記述ではなく、具体的に制御可能な属性を強制する  
各ショットごとに正確なタイムコードと「hard cut」指示を含む MULTISHOT を指定し、15秒シーケンス全体のテンポと編集を制御する  
「character matches input 100%」および「no identity drift」を明示してキャラクターの同一性を固定し、カット間での subject drift を抑える  
画像は STYLE REFERENCE ONLY（固定された keyframe ではない）であると明記し、Seedance に新しい建物やアングルで世界を拡張するよう指示して、入力フレームを 1:1 で再現しないようにする  
24fps を明示的に設定し、スローモーションを禁止する（「NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed」）ことで、モーションのテンポを制御する  
「No jitter」を明示的に指示しつつ、意図的な handheld shake のパラメータ（例: 4–8cm のバウンス、organic human jitter、no stabilization）を別途定義して、不安定なアーティファクトを減らす  
各カットごとに FOV 値、dutch angle の角度、そして movement（tracking、whip、arc、push-in、recoil）を指定して、ショットごとの camera behavior を制御する  
white balance（WB 6500K）と 60:30:10 の dominant/secondary/accent カラー比率を指定して、一貫したルックを維持する  
「Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic」や「NO glowing eyes」のような negative constraints を追加して、不要な stylization を防ぐ  
「180° shutter motion blur」、gravity/inertia、正しい contact shadows、見える breath/chest rise、pore-level skin detail などの物理的な手がかりを明示的に促し、リアリズムを高める  
16:9 と「Cut to black at end」を指定して、出力フォーマットと終わり方を制御する  
「Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.」と指定して、音声生成を制御する

ko.content:
구조화된 Seedance prompt 템플릿을 사용하고, 라벨이 붙은 섹션(Style, Cinematography, Lighting, Color, Camera, Skin, Acting, Physics, Composition, Continuity, Technical, Audio)을 통해 모호한 묘사 대신 구체적으로 제어 가능한 속성을 강제하세요.  
정확한 타임코드와 각 샷별 “hard cut” 지시를 포함한 MULTISHOT을 지정해, 15초 시퀀스 전반의 페이싱과 편집을 제어하세요.  
“character matches input 100%”와 “no identity drift”를 명시적으로 적어 캐릭터 정체성을 고정하고, 컷 사이에서 subject drift를 줄이세요.  
참조 이미지 사용 방식은 해당 이미지가 STYLE REFERENCE ONLY이며(고정 keyframe이 아님), Seedance가 입력 프레임을 1:1로 재현하지 않도록 새로운 건물/앵글로 세계를 확장하라고 지시해 명확히 하세요.  
24fps를 명시하고 slow motion을 금지해 모션 cadence를 제어하세요(“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”).  
“No jitter”를 명시적으로 지시하는 동시에, 의도적인 handheld shake 파라미터(예: 4–8cm bounce, organic human jitter, no stabilization)를 별도로 정의해 불안정한 아티팩트를 줄이세요.  
각 컷마다 FOV 값, dutch angle 각도, 그리고 movement(tracking, whip, arc, push-in, recoil)를 지정해 샷별 카메라 동작을 직접 제어하세요.  
white balance(WB 6500K)와 60:30:10의 dominant/secondary/accent color 비율을 지정해 일관된 룩을 유지하세요.  
“Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” 및 “NO glowing eyes” 같은 negative constraints를 추가해 원치 않는 스타일화를 방지하세요.  
180° shutter motion blur, gravity/inertia, 정확한 contact shadows, 보이는 breath/chest rise, pore-level skin detail 같은 물리적 단서를 명시적으로 prompt하여 사실감을 높이세요.  
16:9와 “Cut to black at end”를 지정해 출력 형식과 종료 방식을 제한하세요.  
“Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.”라고 명시해 오디오 생성을 제어하세요.

Especifique MULTISHOT com timecodes exatos e instruções de “hard cut” por shot para controlar o ritmo e a edição ao longo de uma sequência de 15s  
Trave a identidade do personagem declarando explicitamente “character matches input 100%” e “no identity drift” para reduzir o desvio do sujeito entre os cortes  
Esclareça o uso da imagem de referência dizendo que a imagem é APENAS STYLE REFERENCE (não um keyframe fixo) e instrua o Seedance a expandir o mundo com novos prédios/ângulos para que ele não recrie o frame de entrada 1:1  
Controle a cadência do movimento definindo explicitamente 24fps e proibindo slow motion (“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”)  
Reduza artefatos de instabilidade instruindo explicitamente “No jitter” enquanto define separadamente parâmetros intencionais de tremor handheld (por exemplo, bounce de 4–8cm, organic human jitter, no stabilization)  
Direcione o comportamento da câmera por shot especificando valores de FOV, graus de dutch angle e movimento (tracking, whip, arc, push-in, recoil) para cada corte  
Imponha um visual consistente especificando white balance (WB 6500K) e uma proporção de cores dominante/secundária/acento de 60:30:10  
Evite estilização indesejada adicionando restrições negativas como “Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” e “NO glowing eyes”  
Melhore o realismo instruindo explicitamente pistas físicas (motion blur de shutter 180°, gravity/inertia, contact shadows corretas, breath/chest rise visíveis, skin detail em nível de poros)  
Restrinja o formato de saída e o final especificando 16:9 e “Cut to black at end”  
Controle a geração de áudio especificando “Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.”

zh.content:
使用带有标注分区的结构化 Seedance prompt 模板（Style、Cinematography、Lighting、Color、Camera、Skin、Acting、Physics、Composition、Continuity、Technical、Audio），以强制指定可控属性，而不是使用模糊的描述词  
通过为每个 shot 指定精确的时间码和 “hard cut” 指令来设置 MULTISHOT，从而控制 15 秒序列中的节奏和剪辑  
通过明确写出 “character matches input 100%” 和 “no identity drift” 来锁定角色身份，减少跨 cut 的主体漂移  
通过说明参考图像仅作为 STYLE REFERENCE ONLY（不是固定 keyframe），并指示 Seedance 用新的建筑/角度扩展世界，避免 1:1 复现输入画面，来明确参考图的使用方式  
通过明确设置 24fps 并禁止慢动作（“NO slow-motion anywhere — everything 24fps full speed”）来控制运动节奏  
通过明确指示 “No jitter”，同时单独定义有意的 handheld shake 参数（例如 4–8cm bounce、organic human jitter、no stabilization），来减少不稳定伪影  
通过为每个 cut 指定 FOV 数值、dutch angle 角度以及运动方式（tracking、whip、arc、push-in、recoil），来逐 shot 直接控制 camera 行为  
通过指定白平衡（WB 6500K）和 60:30:10 的主色/辅色/点缀色比例，来确保一致的视觉风格  
通过添加负向约束来防止不想要的风格化，例如 “Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic” 和 “NO glowing eyes”  
通过明确提示物理线索（180° shutter motion blur、gravity/inertia、正确的接触阴影、可见的呼吸/胸部起伏、毛孔级皮肤细节）来提升真实感  
通过指定 16:9 和 “Cut to black at end” 来约束输出格式和结尾  
通过指定 “Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.” 来控制音频生成
